title.narrative: Kolkata Resilience Response under KMC ( Kolkata Municipal Corporation )

description.narrative: The Kolkata Resilience Response under KMC is intended to meet the critical needs, following a Rapid Needs Assessment (RNA) and discussions with borough chairmen and ward representatives. The project will benefit 1,756 households (about 8,712 people) in eight of the most hit wards and has three components. WASH and NFI kits will be delivered to 1,100 households (5,457 people). Multipurpose Cash Transfers (MPCT) & cash for work will assist a total 656 HH / 3255 population. Both direct unconditional cash transfer (for 350 HH) and Cash for Work for drainage cleaning and small repair of water structure (for 306 HH) is to allow families to address urgent, self-prioritized expenditures like food, medicine, and temporary repairs. Beneficiaries are chosen on the basis of confirmed house damage and loss of livelihood, without duplication with WASH–NFI recipients. Protection, Hygiene, activities will be delivered to all 1,756 households (8,712 individuals) through 16 awareness sessions on gender-based violence, hygiene, health, disaster preparedness, and safeguarding. Protection mainstreaming principles of Safety, Access, and Dignity are integrated throughout the approach.
